derivation: recognition is a READ over history the records already carry (#80 record, #267 return history, #114 meeting persistence) — stored nowhere, in #207's derivation idiom; it is a third read BESIDE #207's species states (unseen/seen/kept), never a fourth state

carriers: #224 chronicle (printed sightings/deeds — the belief/record split applies to a face: fame can be WRONG until a correction prints)
#93 town data (who is talked about here is town data)
fame.law: fame is a fact in the world's public layer, NEVER a stat on the individual; an unprinted individual has no fame however distinctive he is
fame.readBy: NPC greeting/staging (#93 beats) and the show's arrival grammar (#276/#319 show lane)

fuels: personal history (met this individual — cannot be faked)
public story (fame — can be wrong; kept as a separate fuel on purpose)
recognition.key: the visible distinction: a #318 registered deviation first, a #322 generated distinction second
recognition.presents: the INDIVIDUAL, not the species: own record, nickname (#239), variation + deviation rendered (#325), this Ranger's history beats with this individual (#267/#273 facts)
recognition.workedCase: the maskless Verdilance is identifiable anywhere — known as THE Verdilance; a species-standard one is known as A Verdilance

wildRead: wild individuals do not read fame (a human-world layer); a wild Mochi's recognition of a Ranger is #152 behaviour
